review_notes: Alignment kept as accepted; the only change is to the s009 note, which cited rule 88 alongside rule 86. Rule 88 governs a supplied coordinating 'and' at a participle-to-finite seam, and no such juncture stands here, so the citation was dropped and the head reasoning made explicit.
Partition verified: s001–s016 and t001–t019 each appear exactly once, and both unrepresented units carry a valid source head with an empty target and null target head.

Both articles are unrepresented under rule 20 rather than aligned: ἡμῶν and αὐτοῦ are free genitive pronouns carrying nothing else, so rule 76's availability test does not reach them and neither article has a determiner left to take.

The competing reading for s009 would split 'in that' off as `added` under rule 86; rejected because a participle is exactly the token rule 86 names as licensing a supplied subordinator, so the whole frame stays with ἀνενέγκας.

'Was' is kept with ἐδικαιώθη rather than read as an interrogative supplied word: the passive requires the auxiliary, and rule 63 refuses to read a verb off inverted English word order. No interrogative particle stands in the source, so rules 44 and 64 are not in question and οὐκ is an ordinary negative on 'not'.
